English | 简体中文
A DeepSeek Harness bundle that hires agy-staff's personas as seven skills — /agy-ask, /agy-staffer,
/agy-researcher, /agy-reviewer, /agy-implementer, plus /agy-lead and /agy-jobs.
**Why · Install · Usage · Core design · Control panel · Updating · Troubleshooting · Credits**
## What & Why
agy-staff hires Google's Antigravity CLI (`agy`, Gemini 3.8 Flash) as staff: the host agent hands ou
t a survey, a review, or a scoped implementation, and gets a second model family back in seconds ins
tead of grinding the same work itself. It ships as plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and OpenCode.
DeepSeek Harness is not one of those hosts. **dsh plugins are cordis bundles**, not host plugin mani
fests, and dsh has no `/agy:` namespace: its composer menu matches the skill *name* from frontmatter
, discovered through a registered **skill provider**. So this repo is not an installer script that c
opies files around — it is a dsh bundle that registers one provider serving the vendored personas:

## CUJs
| Use case | Type this |

| Quick second opinion | `/agy-ask what's your backend model` |
| General task | `/agy-staffer summa

rize the open TODOs in this repo` |
| Generate an image | `/agy-staffer generate a pixel-art robot m

ascot, save it as assets/mascot.png` |
| Review the working tree | `/agy-reviewer Review the current

working tree` |
| Review a PR | `/agy-reviewer Review PR #12` |
| Challenge a plan | `/agy-reviewer

Challenge the migration plan in docs/plan.md` |
| Survey a topic | `/agy-researcher how does auth w

ork in this repo` |
| Scoped implementation | `/agy-implementer fix the flaky retry test` |
| Orches
trate a task | `/agy-lead investigate the options, draft a proposal, then revise it with my feedback

` |
| Job ops | `/agy-jobs`, or just "is the agy job done?" |
Only `ask` blocks. The rest return a job id; the companion's `wait` collects the report, and in dsh
you run that `wait` as a background command so the host keeps working — one wait per job, `exit 2` m
as a background command so the host keeps working — one wait per job, `exit 2` means still running.
## Core design
- **One provider, seven candidates.** `index.js` parses the vendored `assets/skills/<persona>/SKILL.
md` frontmatter, serves the body as skill content, and reports `rank: 600` (the packaged-provider pr

ecedence). It has no dependencies — Node builtins only.
- **Name prefix is load-bearing.** dsh has n
o colon namespace; `/agy` only lists something if the *name* starts with `agy`. The bundle therefore
serves `agy-<persona>` while the on-disk directory keeps upstream's `ask`/`jobs`, so `../jobs/SKILL

.md` still resolves as written.
- **Every path is resolved before the model sees it.** Upstream writ
es `<skill-dir>/../../companion/agy-companion.mjs` and delegates the resolution to its host; under d
sh that reads as a riddle, so the first run of every fresh session wasted a turn globbing for the co
mpanion and another one retrying. The provider now rewrites `<skill-dir>`, `<plugin-root>`, `../jobs
/…`, `../../companion/…` and `../../docs/…` to absolute paths and prepends a "these are resolved, do
not search" block. The command runs as written, first try, every time — the vendored bytes stay unt

ouched.
- **`resourceBase` is still advertised.** `{ kind: 'directory', path: <pkg>/assets }` remain
s the fallback for anything the rewrite did not catch, so a reference upstream adds tomorrow still r

esolves.
- **`agy` is also a subagent.** `agy-subagent.js` registers an out-of-process `SubagentProv
ider` and the bundle mounts `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent` with `provider: agy, toolName: agy`, so
the model can hand a whole task to Antigravity as a child agent instead of orchestrating a shell co
mmand and a job id. Capabilities are advertised as `false` across the board (no `agentOptions`/`agen
tPreset`/`outputSchema`/depth limit) because a child in another process cannot honor them, and the c
hild inherits no conversation. Environment knobs: `DSH_AGY_SUBAGENT_MODE` (default `staffer`), `DSH_

AGY_SUBAGENT_TIMEOUT_MS`, `DSH_AGY_COMPANION`.
- **Prose is localized at load.** Upstream bodies say
`/agy:ask`; the provider rewrites that to `/agy-ask` in descriptions and bodies, leaving the vendor

ed files byte-identical to upstream.
